evidence: Labeled P2P and modifies peer connection handling and compact block relay in src/net.cpp, src/net.h, and src/net_processing.cpp.
rationale: Allows operators to manually configure BIP152 high-bandwidth compact block relay with explicit peers. As noted in the description, 'an operator may run nodes in multiple locations or maintain a stable, low-latency peering link and want that connection to announce compact blocks immediately and consistently', providing a clear, worthwhile feature for specialized network setups without fixing an active bug or altering protocol-level consensus rules.
